_note: eBay settings for the IMAGE-BASED wall-art catalogue. Taken from the seller's LIVE listings, not invented. WALLART_REPRICE.csv is their active-listings export; it shows category 'Art Prints (360)' and variations written as Color=Black;Unframed Print Only|Size=A3 (29.7x42 cm), with Black at 19.99 and Unframed Print Only at 8.99. That is where the 'Unframed Print Only' colour value and the no-space 'A3 (29.7x42 cm)' size string come from - both copied, not guessed. plan.json on claude/hopeful-rubin-u14pgu supplies condition, dispatch, profiles and the 500,000-row cap.
_pricing_note: The seller's go-to prices, given 22 Oct. The old flat 19.99 framed / 8.99 print was a cheaper structure used while an account had lower selling limits, and is superseded.
_print_only_note: No separate picture is rendered for the unframed option, by the seller's decision on 22 Oct: the variation carries no PicURL, so eBay falls back to the listing's main image, which is the black frame. This matches how their existing listings already sell unframed prints.
_store_price_note: Per-store adjustment in GBP, added to every price for that bucket. The seller set lunar-kms higher on 22 Oct: +10 on framed, +5 on unframed. A bucket with no entry here uses the base prices above. Adjustments are ADDED, so changing a base price moves every store together and keeps the gap.
